name: Hamar Weyne (Xamar Weyne) old district, with Fakhr ad-Din and Arba'a Rukun mosques
subtitle: Hamar Weyne is one of the two old quarters of Mogadishu, the other being Shangani.

facts.label: Old city
facts.value: Two sections, Shangani and Hamar-Weyne; Shangani thought older

parts.text: Hamar Weyne is one of the two old quarters of Mogadishu, the other being Shangani. It holds medieval mosques including Fakhr ad-Din.
